# Subway Seat for k9s

Gold breadcrumbs with the current view in orange, like a line of station signs, and resource states in avocado, gold, orange and red.

[k9s](https://k9scli.io) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/k9s/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.yaml`](subway-seat.yaml) | `~/.config/k9s/skins/subway-seat.yaml` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.yaml`](subway-seat-tunnel.yaml) | `~/.config/k9s/skins/subway-seat-tunnel.yaml` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.yaml`](subway-seat-enamel.yaml) | `~/.config/k9s/skins/subway-seat-enamel.yaml` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in k9s config.yaml (`k9s info` shows where), with the skin in its skins/ folder:

```yaml
k9s:
  ui:
    skin: subway-seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in k9s config.yaml (`k9s info` shows where), with the skin in its skins/ folder:

```yaml
k9s:
  ui:
    skin: subway-seat-tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in k9s config.yaml (`k9s info` shows where), with the skin in its skins/ folder:

```yaml
k9s:
  ui:
    skin: subway-seat-enamel
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/k9s/skins/subway-seat.yaml`.
- Delete `~/.config/k9s/skins/subway-seat-tunnel.yaml`.
- Delete `~/.config/k9s/skins/subway-seat-enamel.yaml`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
